rows.ja: ゲーム機プラットフォーム(許諾・製造)
配信・広告プラットフォームと競合

relations.text: MicrosoftがXbox対応製品の開発・発売などの権利を許諾するライセンス契約を結んでいる
relations.text_en: Microsoft granted a license to develop, publish, manufacture, market and sell Xbox compatible products under license agreements

source.label: Take-Two Interactive 10-K
source.quote: Under the terms of the license agreements that we have entered into with Microsoft Corporation and its affiliates, Microsoft granted us the right and license to develop, publish, have manufactured, market, advertise, distribute and sell Xbox compatible products.

relations.text: 製品の製造は、Microsoftが承認した複製業者に発注している
relations.text_en: Manufacturing orders are placed with Microsoft's approved replicator

source.label: Take-Two Interactive 10-K
source.quote: We place a purchase order for the manufacture of our products with Sony, Nintendo, or Microsoft's approved replicator and then send software code to the manufacturer, together with related artwork, user instructions, warranty information, brochures and packaging designs for approval, defect testing and manufacture.

relations.text: 年次報告が、Microsoftをゲーム発売元の競合に挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report lists Microsoft among competing game publishers

source.label: Take-Two Interactive 10-K
source.quote: We also compete with game publishers, such as Electronic Arts, Embracer Group, Epic Games, Microsoft, Nintendo, Playrix, Playtika, Roblox, Savvy Games, Sony, Tencent, and Ubisoft.

relations.text_en: Platform manufacturers such as Nintendo manufacture or control the approved manufacturers of physical software copies for their hardware

source.label: Take-Two Interactive 10-K
source.quote: Platform manufacturers, such as Sony, Microsoft, and Nintendo, either manufacture or control the selection of approved manufacturers of physical copies of software products sold for use on their respective hardware platforms.

relations.text: JPMorgan Chase Bankなどが参加するクレジット契約(2022年5月23日付)をTake-Twoが締結している
relations.text_en: Take-Two has a credit agreement dated May 23, 2022 with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. and others

source.label: Take-Two Interactive 10-K

source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: 同クレジット契約の第1次修正(2024年5月14日付)がある
relations.text_en: Amendment No. 1 to the credit agreement is dated May 14, 2024

source.label: Take-Two Interactive 10-K
source.quote: 10.34 Amendment No. 1 to Credit Agreement, dated as of May 14, 2024, by and among Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc., and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.

relations.text: Wells Fargo Bank, N.A.との売掛債権買取契約(2025年5月19日付)をTake-Two、Zyngaが締結している
relations.text_en: Take-Two and Zynga have a Receivables Purchase Agreement dated May 19, 2025 with Wells Fargo Bank, N.A.

source.label: Take-Two Interactive 10-K
source.quote: 10.37 Receivables Purchase Agreement, dated as of May 19, 2025, by and among Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc., Zynga Inc., and Wells Fargo Bank, N.A.**
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。
